# Unspooled

> Unspooled is a student-led initiative from West Windsor-Plainsboro, New Jersey, helping teenagers break the cycle of compulsive social media use (the "Overstimulation Cycle").

Contact: team@unspooled.org

## Pages

- [Home](https://unspooled.org/): Overview, key survey statistics, and the Overstimulation Cycle
- [The Problem](https://unspooled.org/problem): Research, local WW-P survey results, stakeholders, current solutions, and sources
- [Our Team](https://unspooled.org/team): The six students behind Unspooled and the project timeline
- [Events](https://unspooled.org/events): Upcoming and ongoing workshops, challenges, and giveaways
- [Videos](https://unspooled.org/videos): Team videos about screen time and healthier digital habits
- [Get Involved](https://unspooled.org/get-involved): How teens, parents, educators, and organizations can help
- [Take the Survey](https://unspooled.org/survey): Anonymous survey on teen social media habits in WW-P
- [Contact](https://unspooled.org/contact): Partnerships, events, and social media handles
